name: Exercise — Tabletop Half-Day
description: A simple half-day tabletop exercise (0900–1200). Participants discuss a scenario around a table with no live systems. Ideal for leadership decision-making practice, policy validation, or introducing new staff to exercise methodology.

groups.name: Facilitator
groups.description: Exercise facilitator delivering injects and guiding discussion

roles.name: Facilitator
roles.description: Leads discussion, delivers scenario injects, manages time

roles.name: Note-Taker
roles.description: Records decisions, actions, and key discussion points

events.title: Welcome & Ground Rules
events.description: Facilitator introduces the exercise, ground rules, and expected outcomes.

events.title: Scenario Presentation
events.description: Present the scenario background. Distribute any handouts or situation reports.

events.title: INJECT #1 — Opening Situation
events.description: First scenario inject. Participants discuss: What would you do? Who do you call? What information do you need?

events.title: Group Discussion Round 1
events.description: Open discussion on inject #1. Each group or role describes their response.

events.title: INJECT #2 — Escalation
events.description: Situation escalates. New information changes the picture. Discuss revised response.

events.title: Group Discussion Round 2
events.description: Discuss inject #2. Focus on coordination, communication, and resource needs.

events.title: INJECT #3 — Resolution Dilemma
events.description: Final inject presenting a decision dilemma. No perfect answer — focus on trade-offs.

events.title: Decision & Discussion Round 3
events.description: Final discussion round. Participants make and justify a decision.

events.title: Key Takeaways
events.description: Facilitator summarises key decisions, gaps identified, and lessons learned.

events.title: Actions & Close
events.description: Capture follow-up actions. Thank participants. Exercise concludes.
